<thought>First, retrieve polymorph data for 40 oxide compositions using the provided batch tool with the specified energy and per‑composition limits, saving the JSON files into the working directory. Then list the directory to see the generated files so we can consolidate them.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2","Fe2O3","Al2O3","SiO2","ZnO","CuO","NiO","CoO","MnO","Cr2O3",
        "MgO","CaO","Na2O","K2O","PbO","SnO2","V2O5","MoO3","WO3","ZrO2",
        "HfO2","CeO2","Y2O3","La2O3","Gd2O3","Sc2O3","Ti2O3","FeO","Fe3O4",
        "Cu2O","CuO2","Ag2O","AgO","Bi2O3","Sb2O5","GeO2","SiO","B2O3","P2O5"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_8/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
